subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API - follow-up & quick ask on volumes

Hi Samira (and Evan),

Thanks again for taking the call today — great to learn more about Nimbus Labs' use cases. Quick recap + one ask so we can pull together an apples-to-apples pricing range:

- Use case: real-time summarization + search re-ranking for end-user chat.
- Key SLOs: p95 latency < 400ms for generation, retention of logs for 90 days.
- Integration: mostly server-side API calls from our fleet with a small percentage from client-side assistants.

One ask: can you confirm expected monthly token volume and expected peak TPS (requests per second) for the first 6-12 months? Also helpful to know your target unit economics (e.g., target $/1M tokens) or budget range so I can map you to the right Hosted vs Dedicated options.

I'm attaching the usage template we discussed — feel free to drop your numbers in and send back.

Next steps: once I have the numbers I can send a short pricing range (pay-as-you-go vs committed) + an estimated cost example for your top scenarios. If helpful we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week.

Best,
Marissa

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API - follow-up & quick ask on volumes

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick answers below based on our initial internal forecast:

- Expected monthly token volume (month 1-6 ramp): 80,000,000 – 120,000,000 tokens/month (conservative -> target).
- Typical request size: ~40 tokens input + ~60 tokens output on average (100 tokens per interaction).
- Peak TPS: ~40-60 TPS during product launches; steady-state day-to-day peak around 15-20 TPS.
- Target unit economics: we're looking for ~$12–$15 per 1M tokens on average; if committed pricing is available that drops to the single digits we'd consider a commit.
- Budget range (initial pilots): $1k–$2.5k/month, scaling to $5k–$10k/month in Q3 if the pilot goes well.

I've attached our initial forecast CSV. Happy to hop on a call to walk through the numbers.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Director of Product 
Samira.K@nimbuslabs.com
Attachment: initial-forecast.csv (CSV)

Samira — thanks for the detail, that helps a lot. A few quick clarifications and what we can offer as a starting point:

Clarifications:
- When you say 80-120M tokens/month, is that total tokens (input+output)? We'll assume total tokens unless you note otherwise.
- Peak TPS 40-60 — is that sustained for a 10-15 minute launch window or shorter bursts? Either way we have autoscaling options but it affects cold-start and KV cache warm-up expectations.

Preliminary pricing guidance (Hosted API):
- Pay-as-you-go: ~$15 per 1M tokens (no commit).
- Committed (reserved monthly commit): starting around $9 per 1M tokens at the 100M/month commit tier (examples vary by model family).

Example economics (round numbers):
- 100M tokens/month @ $15/1M -> $1,500/month (pay-as-you-go)
- 100M tokens/month @ $9/1M -> $900/month (committed)

On peak TPS: Hosted API can autoscale to 60+ TPS for short bursts and maintain steady 20-30 TPS with low single-digit percentiles for latency. If you need guaranteed capacity and lower latency during large bursts we typically recommend evaluating Dedicated/reserved pools.

Next steps: I can prepare a short two-page pricing summary + a sample quote for both payg and a committed 100M tier. Would you like that in Doc/slide form or a quick follow-up call?

—Marissa

Samira — per your request attached below is a short example showing unit economics and how we handle bursts. This is a quick summary; I'll follow up with a formal one-pager and sample quote later today.

Example unit economics (rounded):
- 80M tokens/month:
  - Pay-as-you-go @ $15/1M = 80 * $15 = $1,200/month
  - Committed @ $9/1M = 80 * $9 = $720/month

- 100M tokens/month:
  - Pay-as-you-go @ $15/1M = 100 * $15 = $1,500/month
  - Committed @ $9/1M = 100 * $9 = $900/month

- 120M tokens/month:
  - Pay-as-you-go @ $15/1M = 120 * $15 = $1,800/month
  - Committed @ $9/1M = 120 * $9 = $1,080/month

Notes on latency & bursts:
- Typical hosted p50/p95 for the model families we discussed: p50 ~ 80-120ms, p95 ~ 350-450ms under steady-state. Short bursts (<= 5 minutes) to 80-100 TPS are possible via autoscaling; however cold-starts and KV cache warm-up can add 100-300ms for the first few requests.
- If you need guaranteed burst capacity with warm caches and lower cold-start risk, we recommend a Dedicated pool with reserved GPUs and pre-warmed pods. We can include a burst buffer add-on in a Hosted quote (sustained short-burst support with warm instances).

Next steps: I'll attach a one-page pricing summary + a sample quote for 100M/month (payg vs 100M committed) and a note on burst add-on pricing. Can we schedule a 30-min call Wed or Thu to finalize?

Best,
Marissa
